sections.title: 2.3 User Characteristics
sections.text_preview: The Employee is expected to be Internet literate and to be able to track their time off the system. The Manager is expected to be Internet literate as well.

sections.title: 2.4 Non-Functional Requirements
sections.text_preview: The system will be hosted on AWS EC2 instance and will be running on Apache 2. It will use PHP 7 with MySQL. The application should be accesable through both, web and mobile devices.
